name: Triceratops
otherStatistics: AC from natural armor. Passive Perception 10. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A heavy four-legged dinosaur with rough brown hide, a broad bony frill, two long brow horns, a shorter nose horn, and a heavy tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Basic Rules (2018), and printed page 156.
sections.Traits: Trampling Charge. Move at least 20 ft. directly toward a creature and hit it with Gore that turn. The creature must pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone. If that target is prone, the triceratops can Stomp it once as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 24 (4d8 + 6) piercing damage.
Stomp. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit against one prone creature within 5 ft. A hit deals 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: Stomp can be chosen as the normal action against a prone creature. Trampling Charge is what enables the bonus-action Stomp against the creature hit by Gore.

name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
otherStatistics: AC from natural armor. Perception +4. Passive Perception 14. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A huge orange-brown bipedal dinosaur with dark mottling, an oversized toothed head, short two-fingered forelimbs, heavy hind legs, and a long balancing tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Basic Rules (2018), and printed page 157.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail attack against different targets.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit against one target within 10 ft. A hit deals 33 (4d12 + 7) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit is also grappled, escape DC 17, and restrained while grappled. The tyrannosaurus cannot Bite a different target while this grapple lasts.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit against one target within 10 ft. A hit deals 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: The Bite grapples on a hit without a further roll. The grappled creature can spend its action to attempt a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check to escape.
